claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_object: material-conditional maxSize (Large for general, Medium for metal/stone/mineral)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The SRD defines two size caps depending on raw material type: Large-or-smaller for most materials, Medium-or-smaller for metal, stone, or other mineral substances. The current create_object atom has a single maxSize field with no way to express material-dependent sizing. Encoding uses maxSize='large' (the general case) and omits the mineral-specific cap.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're working with metal, stone, or another mineral substance, however, the fabricated object can be no larger than Medium (contained within a 5-foot Cube).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_object: proficiency gate (Artisan's Tools prerequisite for high-skill items)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell cannot be used to create weapons, armor, or other high-skill items unless the caster has proficiency with the relevant Artisan's Tools. No proficiency-gate field exists on create_object or on the direct phase.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You also can't use it to create items that require a high degree of skill—such as weapons and armor—unless you have proficiency with the type of Artisan's Tools used to craft such objects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ObjectFilter.material — extend to cover non-manufactured raw material targeting
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The object attachment targets raw materials in the environment, but ObjectFilter.material only covers 'metal' | 'flammable'. There is no 'raw_material' or 'unprocessed' category to express the raw-stock nature of the targeted objects. Encoding omits the filter entirely.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose raw materials that you can see within range.
